batteryOpt.title: Keep your uploads running
batteryOpt.body: Some phones aggressively close background apps. Allowing Homelander to run unrestricted keeps your recordings uploading after you leave the app.
batteryOpt.statusAllowed: ✓ Allowed — uploads will keep running in the background.
batteryOpt.statusStillRestricted: Still restricted — open Settings → Apps → Homelander → Battery → Unrestricted.
batteryOpt.sectionHow: How to do it on your phone
batteryOpt.fallbackCopy: If that screen isn't on your phone: Settings → Apps → Homelander → Battery → Unrestricted, and turn on Autostart if your phone has it.

xiaomi.label: Xiaomi (MIUI / HyperOS)
xiaomi.steps: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Humyn Labs Capture → Battery saver → No restrictions, and Autostart → on.

oppo.label: Oppo (ColorOS)
oppo.steps: Settings → Battery → App battery management → Humyn Labs Capture → Allow background activity, and Settings → App management → Auto launch → on.

vivo.label: Vivo (FunTouch)
vivo.steps: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Humyn Labs Capture → Allow, and Settings → More settings → Permission management → Autostart → on.

samsung.label: Samsung (One UI)
samsung.steps: Settings → Apps → Humyn Labs Capture → Battery → Unrestricted (turn off "Pause app activity if unused").

stock.label: Stock Android / Pixel
stock.steps: Settings → Apps → Humyn Labs Capture → Battery → Unrestricted.

payments.title: Payments & Earnings
payments.body: Payouts process offline. Your earnings will reflect in the app soon. Keep recording — your data is safe and your payouts are guaranteed.

delete.title: Delete your Humyn account?
delete.body: Your account will be deactivated for 30 days. Log in within that window to restore it. After 30 days, deletion is permanent. Recordings already uploaded remain on our servers.

consent.body: I consent and agree to upload videos of myself and/or others who consent to be recorded; performing certain daily activities/tasks. This content will be used to develop / train AI models and for research purposes. I confirm that I am 18 years or older and have the necessary permissions to share this content. I confirm that no one being recorded is a minor. I consent to my approximate location and IP address being captured alongside each recording. I understand that my data will be stored securely and used in accordance with Humyn's Privacy Policy.
